subject: Standoff Outside Columbus Elementary School
overview: Police peacefully resolved an hour-long standoff with an armed man outside Columbus Elementary School, which triggered a campus lockdown. The incident concluded with the suspect's apprehension and transport to a hospital.

items.title: Standoff with armed suspect
items.summary: Police negotiators responded to an armed man sitting outside Columbus Elementary School while approximately 350 students were inside the building.

items.title: School lockdown and security response
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson confirmed that the school implemented lockdown protocols, securing students in designated areas and monitoring all entry points.

items.title: Apprehension and parent reunification
items.summary: Officers apprehended the suspect without injury and transported him to a hospital, allowing for the eventual reunification of students and parents.
